bm_menu_perk_cod_fmj_desc: Bullets penetrate enemy shields and deal 10% extra damage to armored enemies (Bulldozers, Shields).
bm_menu_perk_cod_full_ammo_desc: Carry a larger reserve of ammo.
bm_menu_perk_cod_disable_desc: Leg shots are much more likely to stagger enemies.
bm_menu_perk_cod_tough_desc: Move 15% faster for 10 seconds after spawning in.
bm_menu_perk_cod_melee_master_desc: Melee kills and kills within 3 meters return 3 bullets to your magazine.
bm_menu_perk_cod_bullet_return_desc: Kills have a 15% chance to refill your magazine.
bm_menu_perk_cod_empty_reload_desc: Reload 30% faster when the magazine is empty.
bm_menu_perk_cod_double_kill_desc: Two kills within 2 seconds refill your magazine.
bm_menu_perk_cod_fast_reload_kill_desc: Damaging an enemy makes you reload 30% faster for 3 seconds.
bm_menu_perk_cod_speed_up_kill_desc: Damaging an enemy gives you a 15% movement speed boost for 2 seconds.
